CITY OF MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  INTRODUCTION OF GUESTS AND PRESENTATIONS
  TUESDAY
  January 15, 2019
  6:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  320 WEST NEWMARK AVENUE
  Monterey Park, CA 91754

  IN APPRECIATION!

For celebrating your 40th Anniversary of being in business as a Japanese gift shop in
 the City of Monterey Park, and for providing a variety of gift options and excellent
  customer service for the community, the City Council extends our appreciation!

  THE JAPAN HOUSE

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!
Of the 75th Anniversary of the Chinese Exclusion Repeal Act of 1943, the City Council
  recognizes and commemorates this special occasion.

  CHINESE AMERICAN CITIZENS ALLIANCE

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)
   IN RECOGNITION!
  For being excellent examples of immigrants who have contributed to the cultural
enrichment and advancement of our Nation, as dual citizens of Ecuador and the United
  States, the City Council applauds your contributions to the community!

  DUAL CITIZEN ECUADORIAN CHEFS

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!
  For all of your accomplishments, born and raised in Monterey Park, Walter “The
  Schoolboy” Sarnoi, graduated from East Los Angeles College, Northern Michigan
  University (Bachelor of Science, Finance), and Azusa Pacific University (Masters,
Business Administration). The City Council is proud of your reputation of balancing full-
  time academic achievements with full-time professional boxing championships!

  WALTER SARNOI

  (Presented by Mayor Pro Tem Liang)
